C-3PO's Emotional Sacrifice
In order to reveal the coordinates to a hidden Sith wayfinder, Finn, Poe, and Rey need C-3PO to translate a forbidden Sith language, but his programming prevents him from doing so. On a visit to Babu Frik's repair shop, the Anzellan reveals a way to bypass the block, but it involves wiping C-3PO's memory completely, meaning he won't have any idea who his friends are.
